decisions.reason: A perfect binder sits at the core of the firm's established finishing portfolio, uses its existing service and spare-parts capabilities, and with the post-COVID print recovery shows no clear shortfall against aspirations that would trigger problemistic search toward dropping it.
The fully automatic perfect binder fits the firm's stated direction of integrated automation and digital print finishing, so management will keep carrying it even if results are still uncertain.
An inline/nearline booklet maker matches digital-print customer demand and the firm's core bookletmaking competence, so it likely meets aspirations and is kept.
